panels.title: Ollama
panels.description: Is the Ollama API reachable from the exporter?

panels.title: Model VRAM
panels.description: VRAM held by loaded models (RTX 3090 = 24 GiB).

panels.title: CPU Offload
panels.description: Part of loaded models that did not fit in VRAM and runs on CPU (slow). Should be 0.

panels.title: Requests (range)
panels.description: Inference requests through the proxy in the selected time range.

panels.title: Avg Generation Speed
panels.description: Output tokens / second of pure generation time (excludes prompt processing and model load).

panels.title: Error Rate
panels.description: Non-2xx error rate across inference endpoints (excludes non-inference/unknown-model probes).

panels.title: Generation Speed by Model
panels.description: Output tokens per second while generating.

panels.title: Token Throughput
panels.description: Total tokens processed per second (prompt + output) across all requests.

panels.title: Time to First Token (p50 / p95)
panels.description: Streaming requests only. Includes queueing, model load and prompt processing.

panels.title: Where Time Goes (per second of wall clock)
panels.description: Seconds Ollama spent loading models, processing prompts and generating, per second. ~1 means busy all the time.

panels.title: Model Load Time
panels.description: High values mean the model was cold-loaded (keep-alive expired or evicted).

panels.title: Loaded Models
panels.description: Models currently resident in memory (from /api/ps, polled on every scrape).

targets.expr: max by (model, family, parameter_size, quantization, runner) (ollama_loaded_model_info{model=~"$model"})

panels.title: Loaded Model Memory Over Time
panels.description: Shows when models are loaded / unloaded and how much VRAM they hold.

panels.title: Disk I/O
panels.description: Reads spike when Ollama loads a model from disk.

list.name: model
list.label: Model

query.query: query_result(group by (model) (ollama_installed_model_info) or group by (model) (ollama_loaded_model_info) or group by (model) (ollama_requests_total{model!="unknown"}))

list.definition: query_result(group by (model) (ollama_installed_model_info) or group by (model) (ollama_loaded_model_info) or group by (model) (ollama_requests_total{model!="unknown"}))
list.description: Filter the whole dashboard by model (installed, loaded or seen by the proxy).
